text:
alex.chen: Quick thread — proposal for the cost dashboard: introduce an 'epochal unit-econ' preview toggle that shows per-tenant credited cache savings vs raw token savings. Want to avoid surprise negative credits. Thoughts?

ben.k: I like the toggle idea. question: how do we define "credited" when multiple tenants touch the same KV prefix? e.g., one tenant primes, another reuses.

chris_r: heuristic idea: if tenant A was the last writer within TTL window, give A primary credit; otherwise split credit proportional to token footprint during the window. simple pseudo: 
```
if last_writer == tenant: credit = full
else: credit = footprint(tenant)/sum(footprints) * total_savings
```
Edgecases: eviction race, cross-tenant warmups.

maria-s: UX concern — if we naively subtract credited savings from tenant B because A primed the cache, B could show a negative delta month-to-month. Suggest cap credited deduction at 0 and show a separate "externalized savings" line so tenants see both their raw tokens saved and credits assigned.

sam-infra: telemetry note: to implement lineage we need two fields in per-request events: `cache_origin_id` (nullable) and `model_sku_variant`. Without `cache_origin_id` we can't attribute warmups. Minimal schema snippet: 
```json
{"request_id": "...", "tenant_id": "...", "model_sku": "gptx-8k-q4", "model_variant": "v2", "cache_origin_id": "abc123", "tokens_generated": 42}
```
Also need a rollout plan for event backfill and a way to tag historic events as approximate.

ben.k: Implementation question: do we compute credits in realtime or in batch for the billing window? realtime is expensive. batch (daily) is fine but UX needs 'preview' that can be wrong until finalized. Maybe mark preview clearly and include a confidence score.

alex.chen: Agreed on batch compute. Preview = fast estimate (hourly) using sampling; final = daily recompute. Add confidence bar.

chris_r: We also need to consider model-level unit economics: quantized variants and different token costs. Split credits by effective per-token-cost: tokens_saved * token_cost(model_variant). That avoids gaming by routing to cheaper variant.

maria-s: Can we show a "why" drilldown when a tenant's credited savings change? small modal: list top 3 cache_origin_ids and top interfering tenants + timestamps. That will help support tickets.

sam-infra: On the infra side, I'll open a PR to add `cache_origin_id` to the tracing pipeline and a consumer job to materialize daily credits. Will also emit a small warning metric when `cache_origin_id` is missing > 1% of requests.

infra-bot: deploy: pr/482 merged to staging — telemetry schema change deployed to staging env.

alex.chen: Action items: (1) sam: PR for telemetry + missing-id metric, (2) chris: batch credit algorithm prototype (cost-weighted split), (3) maria: UX mock for preview toggle + "externalized savings" line, (4) ben: copy for confidence messaging. I'll sync next Tue 11am to review. :thumbsup:

ben.k: acked, adding to my calendar.

chris_r: will start prototyping, keeping it in the cost-service repo.

maria-s: mock incoming today EOD, will include screenshots of modal.

sam-infra: will follow up with staging alerts and a migration plan for backfill.

alex.chen: thanks team — trying to avoid surprises in month-end invoices. :party_parrot:
